decision.observation: 5 mph in gear R, timer 25:07.037, all dots pale. The car has backed out of the pines and stands on grass with the gravel's edge now only a few metres down-frame; the nose still points up-frame.
decision.hypothesis: Reversing translates the car toward the road below without changing its heading. Roughly one more second of reverse should put the tail of the car onto the gravel so that a W conversion rolls forward onto the track.
decision.memory: Pines pin breaking: one S second freed it at 5 mph and the reverse direction is also the direction of the road here, which makes reverse the cheap way to rejoin.
